picks.editorial_note: Purdue leading two of the first 278 DOE Genesis Mission awards signals the university's central role in a flagship national AI-for-science initiative, with real applications like organizing data from the Electron-Ion Collider.
picks.title: 2 Purdue AI research projects selected among the first Genesis Mission awards

picks.editorial_note: A £20 million MRC-funded hub led by Cambridge combining stem cell models with AI could meaningfully accelerate drug development timelines, a high-value bet on AI in preclinical medicine.
picks.title: Cambridge to lead new £20m MRC Hub to transform development of new medicines using stem cells and AI

picks.editorial_note: UCLA's use of generative AI to design entirely novel proteins, building on Nobel laureate David Baker's techniques, represents a genuine scientific frontier with implications for medicine and materials science.
picks.title: UCLA bioengineer Jason Zhang deploys AI to create proteins never before seen in nature

picks.editorial_note: EPFL's VirTues foundation model for spatial tumor proteomics is a substantive advance toward AI-assisted, cross-cancer-type treatment prediction — exactly the kind of scientific breakthrough with direct clinical stakes.
picks.title: AI model maps tumor tissue to improve cancer care

picks.editorial_note: RoboDojo, built with nearly 20 global universities including UC Berkeley and Tsinghua, establishes a new standard benchmark for embodied AI robot reliability — a foundational contribution the field will build on.
picks.title: HKU Pioneers "RoboDojo": The First Hong Kong-Led Unified Benchmark for Embodied AI, Setting New Global Standards for Robot Reliability - Press Releases - Media - HKU

picks.editorial_note: SRI's ARPA-H-funded PARADIGM system, developed with Mayo Clinic and University of Florida, shows AI-guided medical procedures moving from concept toward real clinical deployment — a strong academia-industry-government partnership.
picks.title: AI guides healthcare workers through blood draws, intubation, and more - SRI

picks.editorial_note: University of Alabama's DOE Genesis Mission win with Fermilab pairs AI with particle physics at scale, illustrating how national labs and universities are jointly tackling AI-for-science problems too large for either alone.
picks.title: AI meets particle physics in UA-Led Department of Energy project

picks.editorial_note: A $12 million Army Research Laboratory grant to Penn State for animal-inspired AI sensing in autonomous drones and robots is a substantial defense-funded bet on next-generation robotics perception.
picks.title: $12M grant to build animal-inspired sensing for autonomous drones and robots | Penn State University

picks.editorial_note: Hebrew University's Haim Sompolinsky winning the 2026 Dirac Medal recognizes foundational theoretical work connecting statistical mechanics to neural computation, underscoring the deep science underpinning modern AI.
picks.title: The Hebrew University of Jerusalem Congratulates Prof. Haim Sompolinsky on Receiving the 2026 Dirac Medal

picks.editorial_note: A university-born startup, FastFlowLM, joining AMD to optimize NPU usage for large language models shows academic AI systems research translating directly into commercial semiconductor products.
picks.title: URI professors’ startup team joined semiconductor giant AMD
